reason: Checked against the Gutenberg #26163 HTML of Mitchell’s 1911 Holt translation: the text between the [Pg 7] and [Pg 8] markers reads “We are seeking only the precise meaning that our consciousness gives to this word “exist,” and we find that, for a conscious being, to exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.” Every word of the card matches Mitchell; locator p. 7 of chapter I is right. The only adjustment is the silent capital on “For”, since the card lifts the clause from mid-sentence; that is standard extraction, not minting, though the note could say the clause follows “we find that,”.
